dunk.title: How to Dunk in NBA 2K27
dunk.intro: Every dunk input in NBA 2K27, for Xbox and PlayStation, plus how the dunk meter works and how to time the release.

moves.name: Normal Dunk
moves.input: RT + press X while driving in close range.

moves.name: Two-Hand Dunk
moves.input: RT + move and hold RS up while driving in close range.

moves.name: Dominant or Off-Hand Dunk
moves.input: RT + move and hold RS left or right. The RS direction determines the dunking hand.

moves.name: Controllable Rim Hang
moves.input: When performing a dunk with RS, keep RT held to hang on the rim. Use LS to control swing, and move RS up to pull up on the rim or left/right to lift the legs.

moves.name: Normal Pass
moves.input: Press A to pass. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Bounce Pass
moves.input: Tap B to pass. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Lob Pass
moves.input: Press Y to pass. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Icon Pass
moves.input: Press RB then press the button of the desired receiver. Use LS to lead the receiver in any direction.

moves.name: Wrap Pass
moves.input: Double tap B to pass. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Alley-oop
moves.input: Double tap Y to pass. Use LS to select receiver. To finish the alley-oop, press the button displayed once the meter reaches the make window when receiving the pass.

moves.name: Alley-oop To Self
moves.input: Press X + Y + move LS toward the hoop. To finish the alley-oop, press the button displayed once the meter reaches the make window when receiving the pass.

moves.name: Lead To Basket Pass
moves.input: Press and hold Y to make the selected receiver cut to the basket. Release Y to pass. (Lead To Basket Pass must be enabled in Controller Settings.)

moves.name: Skip Pass
moves.input: Hold A to target a receiver farther away. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Get Open Pass
moves.input: Hold B to call for a teammate to get open. Release B to pass the ball. Use LS to select receiver.

moves.name: Handoff Pass
moves.input: Hold B to call for a teammate to come to the ball for a handoff. Use LS to select receiver. (Handoff/Pitch Pass must be enabled in Controller Settings.)

moves.name: Fake Pass
moves.input: Press Y + B while standing or driving to the hoop.

moves.name: Jump Pass
moves.input: Press X + A while standing or driving to the hoop.

moves.name: Flashy Pass
moves.input: While holding RB, move RS towards a teammate.

moves.name: Full Receiver Control
moves.input: Press and hold B to freely move the selected receiver with LS. Release B to pass. (Full Receiver Control must be enabled in Controller Settings.)

moves.name: Touch Pass
moves.input: Press A before the initial receiver gets the ball. Use LS to select second receiver.

moves.name: Give and Go
moves.input: Press and hold A until the receiver catches the ball. While keeping A held, use LS to move the initial passer, then release A to get the ball back.

moves.name: Rolling Inbound
moves.input: Press Y during baseline inbounds when no defenders are present.

moves.name: Quick Scoop Layup
moves.input: Move and hold RS left or right while driving.

moves.name: Step Through
moves.input: Press and hold RS in any direction to perform a step through after you've lost your dribble. Attempts from far out will result in shots, while trying this near the basket will result in a layup.

moves.name: Normal Layup
moves.input: Press X while driving in close range. OR Move and hold RS up while driving in close range.

moves.name: Euro Step Layup
moves.input: Move RS down left while driving. OR Double tap X while driving.

moves.name: Spin Layup
moves.input: Hold RT and double tap X while driving, then release RT during the animation.

moves.name: Slow Step Decel
moves.input: While performing a euro-step layup, press and hold LT to slow down your gather and try to throw the defense off-balance.

moves.name: Runner / Floater
moves.input: Move and hold RS down while driving in close range.

moves.name: Reverse Layup
moves.input: Move and hold RS right while driving along the right baseline.

moves.name: Hop Step Finish
moves.input: RT + move RS down left or right while driving. OR Tap X while driving.

moves.name: Post Go-To Shot
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. With LS neutral, move and hold RS up.

moves.name: Post Hook
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. With LS neutral, move and hold RS up left or up right.

moves.name: Post Fade
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move and hold RS left or right away from the hoop.

moves.name: Post Shimmy Hook
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT + move and hold RS up left or up right.

moves.name: Post Shimmy Fade
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT + move and hold RS left or right.

moves.name: Post Up and Under
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Use RS to pump fake, then let go of LT and quickly move and hold RS again before the pump fake ends.

moves.name: Post Layup
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move LS toward the hoop + hold RS up left or up right.

moves.name: Post Dunk Attempt
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT and move LS + RS up.

moves.name: Post Hop Shot
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move and hold LS left, right, or down then tap X. OR Hold RT + move and hold RS away from the hoop.

moves.name: Post Pump Fake
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move RS in any direction then quickly release (while holding the ball).

moves.name: Enter and Leave Post
moves.input: Press and hold LT to post up. Release LT to leave the post and faceup.

moves.name: Post Pivot
moves.input: Press and hold LT to post up. Move LS in any direction then quickly release (while holding the ball).

moves.name: Drop Step
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move and hold LS left or right toward the hoop then tap X.

moves.name: Spin or Drive
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Then, rotate RS to either shoulder.

moves.name: Switch Facing
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move RS up then quickly release.

moves.name: Drive Fake
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT and move RS towards the inside shoulder then quickly release.

moves.name: Spin Fake
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT and move RS towards the outside shoulder then quickly release.

moves.name: Post Step-Away
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT and move RS down then quickly release.

moves.name: Disengage Away
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Then, release LT while moving and holding the LS away from the basket.

moves.name: Aggressive Backdown
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Hold RT + LS toward the defender.

moves.name: Avoid Steal
moves.input: Hold LT to post up. Move RS down and quickly release.
